_description: Multi-turn problem-solving with sample-level mode=on + effort=high — encoder should signal high-effort thinking on assistant turns per family conventions.

blocks.text: A train leaves city A at 9:00 traveling 80 km/h. Another leaves city B at 10:00 traveling 100 km/h toward A. Cities are 540 km apart. When do they meet?
By 10:00 the first train has covered 80 km, leaving 460 km between them. Closing speed is 180 km/h, so they meet 460/180 ≈ 2.556 hours after 10:00 — at about 12:33.
Where do they meet, measured from A?
From 9:00 to ~12:33 is 3.556 hours. At 80 km/h, train A has traveled 80 × 3.556 ≈ 284.4 km from A.
